user.description: Pick the Pecron power station (advertises as QUEC_BLE_xxxx or with Quectel manufacturer data).

manual_address.description:
No Pecron power station was found automatically. Make sure it is switched on, within range of a Bluetooth adapter or active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, and that the Pecron app on your phone is closed (the station accepts only one Bluetooth connection, and stops advertising while the app is connected).

If it still isn't found, enter its Bluetooth address. You can read it with a BLE scanner app such as nRF Connect.

auth_method.description: The power station encrypts its Bluetooth link with a per-device auth key. It is only available from Pecron's cloud. Fetch it once with your Pecron app login (the password is not stored), or paste a key you already have.

menu_options.pecron_local: Reuse the key from the Pecron Local integration
menu_options.cloud: Sign in to Pecron once to fetch the key

cloud.description: Used once to read the device auth key. Nothing is stored except the key.

cloud_device.description: Which device on your account is {name}?

manual.description: Base64 auth key (decodes to 16, 24 or 32 bytes), e.g. from pecron-monitor --setup.

pecron_local.description: Pick the Pecron Local entry for this power station. Its auth key is copied over without being shown.

error.invalid_key_format: Not a base64 string that decodes to 16, 24 or 32 bytes.
error.invalid_auth: The power station rejected this auth key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect over Bluetooth. Make sure it is in range and not connected to the Pecron app.
error.not_in_range: The power station is not currently visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.cloud_auth: Pecron login failed. Check email, password and region.
error.cloud_unreachable: Could not reach the Pecron cloud.
error.no_cloud_devices: No devices are bound to this Pecron account.

abort.not_connectable: Found a Pecron power station ({addresses}), but only a scanner that cannot connect sees it. ESPHome Bluetooth proxies must have active connections enabled (`bluetooth_proxy: active: true`), or move the station closer to a connectable adapter.
abort.auth_key_unavailable: The Pecron cloud did not give a usable auth key for {device}: {error}

not_in_range.message: Pecron {address} is not in Bluetooth range
